driver-heading.purpose: Introduce the native driver choices. Mobile uses 13px, and short touch landscape uses 14px.

driver-name.purpose: Identify DHH and Ryan beside their pixel portraits. Mobile and short touch landscape use 12px.

shadows.name: cabinet
shadows.purpose: Separate the cabinet from the page.

shadows.name: hud-text
shadows.purpose: Protect instrument text over the scene.

shadows.name: countdown-text
shadows.purpose: Keep the countdown distinct from the road.

shadows.name: race-message-text
shadows.purpose: Keep race messages legible over the scene.

motion.name: button-feedback
motion.purpose: Provide short color feedback on buttons. Reduced motion removes the transition.

motion.name: driver-choice-feedback
motion.purpose: Provide border and fill feedback on driver choices. Reduced motion removes the transition.

motion.name: world-travel
motion.purpose: Multiply rendered world distance to strengthen the sense of speed.

motion.name: boost-projection
motion.purpose: Ease toward focal length 42 during boost. Normal and reduced-motion views target 55.

motion.name: speed-lines
motion.purpose: Draw peripheral streaks from 160 km/h. Intensity reaches one at 460 km/h. Reduced motion hides them.

motion.name: cameo-cooldown
motion.purpose: The first boost of each run introduces the selected driver. Each cameo starts this cooldown before later boost onsets qualify.

motion.name: cameo-chance
motion.purpose: After the introduction, each eligible boost onset uses this chance to show the selected driver. A held boost does not retrigger the cameo.

motion.name: cameo-sequence
motion.purpose: The selected driver emerges over 0.4s, turns at 0.6s, and smiles at 0.88s. The name tag appears from 0.95s to 1.8s. Return starts at 1.85s and ends at 2.6s.

motion.name: cameo-rise
motion.purpose: Ease the head out of the window. The rise value spans zero to one over 0.4s.

motion.name: cameo-return
motion.purpose: Lower the head over 0.75s. Early boost release advances to this phase.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Remove decorative travel, streaks, shake, bounce, tilt, flicker, scanlines, and button and driver-choice transitions. Show the selected driver's stationary smile after 0.15s and before 2.25s. Keep gameplay and exhaust active.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Start, resume, and retry use the gold pixel action.
components.html: <button class="ds-primary" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 2h3v3h3v3h3v3H9v3H6v2H3z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>START ENGINE</button>
components.css: .ds-primary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; min-height: 49px; padding: 0 27px; border: 1px solid var(--yellow-bright, #ffd578); border-radius: 0; background: var(--yellow, #e0af68); color: var(--night, #1a1b26); font-family: 'Arcade', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.7; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-primary svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; stroke: none; } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--yellow-bright, #ffd578); } .ds-primary:active { background: #c99a57; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #7dcfff); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-primary:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: .36; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-primary { min-height: 44px; padding-inline: 16px; gap: 9px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Toolbar action
components.description: The sound control demonstrates muted, hover, pressed, and disabled toolbar states. The arcade container adds compact styles at widths up to 600px.
components.css: .ds-arcade { container-type: inline-size; } .ds-tool { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 44px; padding: 0 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #9aa5ce); font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: .2px; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-tool svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-tool:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--yellow, #e0af68); } .ds-tool[aria-pressed='true'] { color: var(--cyan, #7dcfff); } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #7dcfff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-tool:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: .36; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-tool { min-width: 40px; padding-inline: 3px; justify-content: center; } .ds-tool span { display: none; } } @container (max-width: 600px) { .ds-tool { min-width: 40px; padding-inline: 3px; justify-content: center; } .ds-tool span { display: none; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-tool { transition: none; } }

components.name: Text action
components.description: Secondary actions sit below the primary action in pause and results panels.
components.css: .ds-text-action { padding: 16px; border: none; border-radius: 0; background: none; color: var(--muted, #9aa5ce); font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: .8px; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-text-action:hover { color: var(--text, #c0caf5); } .ds-text-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #7dcfff); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-text-action:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: .36; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-text-action { padding: 12px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-text-action { transition: none; } }

components.name: Touch action
components.description: Steer and brake share a rectangular touch surface. Active feedback represents the held pointer state.
components.css: .ds-touch { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; min-width: 55px; height: 54px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #343b58); border-radius: 0; background: var(--panel, #24283b); color: var(--text, #c0caf5); font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: .4px; cursor: pointer; touch-action: none; user-select: none; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-touch:active:not(:disabled), .ds-touch.ds-pressed { background: var(--line, #343b58); border-color: var(--cyan, #7dcfff); } .ds-touch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #7dcfff); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-touch:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: .36; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-touch { padding-inline: 10px; } } @media (max-height: 520px) and (orientation: landscape) and (pointer: coarse) { .ds-touch { min-width: 52px; padding-inline: 8px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-touch { transition: none; } }

components.name: Touch nitro action
components.description: Yellow text and an inline bolt distinguish boost from the other touch controls.
components.html: <button class="ds-touch-nitro" type="button">NITRO<svg viewBox="0 0 16 20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 0 2 11h5l-1 9 8-12H9z" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-touch-nitro { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; min-width: 55px; height: 54px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #e0af6870; border-radius: 0; background: var(--panel, #24283b); color: var(--yellow, #e0af68); font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: .4px; cursor: pointer; touch-action: none; user-select: none; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-touch-nitro svg { width: 23px; height: 23px; } .ds-touch-nitro:active:not(:disabled), .ds-touch-nitro.ds-pressed { background: var(--line, #343b58); border-color: var(--cyan, #7dcfff); } .ds-touch-nitro:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #7dcfff); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-touch-nitro:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: .36; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-touch-nitro { padding-inline: 10px; } } @media (max-height: 520px) and (orientation: landscape) and (pointer: coarse) { .ds-touch-nitro { min-width: 52px; padding-inline: 8px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-touch-nitro { transition: none; } }

components.name: Driver choice
components.description: Native radios choose DHH or Ryan before each new run. The full selector pairs each choice with a pixel portrait canvas. DHH's updated smile sprite follows the supplied `~/dhh.jpg` photo. It shows wavy chestnut-brown hair, blue-gray eyes, rosy cheeks, a short gray-flecked beard, and a broad smile. The selector uses `Wavy hair and beard.` as the detail label.
components.css: .ds-driver-roster { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 18px; width: min(100%, 464px); padding: 0; margin: 0 0 22px; border: 0; min-width: 0; text-align: center; } .ds-driver-option { position: relative; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; user-select: none; } .ds-driver-input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; } .ds-driver-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 16px 18px 14px; border: 2px solid var(--line, #343b58); border-radius: 0; background: var(--panel, #24283b); transition: border-color 120ms ease-out, background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-driver-card strong { font: 14px 'Arcade', monospace; color: var(--text, #c0caf5); } .ds-driver-option:hover .ds-driver-card { border-color: var(--muted, #9aa5ce); } .ds-driver-input:checked + .ds-driver-card { border-color: var(--yellow, #e0af68); background: #2d2c3d; } .ds-driver-input:checked + .ds-driver-card strong { color: var(--yellow, #e0af68); } .ds-driver-input:focus-visible + .ds-driver-card { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #7dcfff); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-driver-roster { gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 20px; } .ds-driver-card { padding: 12px 8px; } .ds-driver-card strong { font-size: 12px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-driver-card { transition: none; } }

components.name: Nitro meter
components.description: The track uses a left-origin fill. The boost class selects yellow feedback.
components.html:
NITRO
HOLD TO BOOST
components.css: .ds-nitro { font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; text-shadow: 0 2px 4px var(--bg, #16161e); } .ds-nitro-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 10px; color: var(--cyan, #7dcfff); letter-spacing: 1px; } .ds-nitro-track { box-sizing: border-box; height: 10px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid #565f89; background: var(--night, #1a1b26); } .ds-nitro-fill { height: 100%; background: var(--cyan, #7dcfff); transform-origin: left; transform: scaleX(.65); } .ds-nitro.ds-boosting .ds-nitro-fill { background: var(--yellow, #e0af68); } .ds-nitro-state { display: block; margin-top: 10px; color: var(--muted, #9aa5ce); letter-spacing: .4px; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-nitro-label { margin-bottom: 8px; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-nitro-state { margin-top: 7px; letter-spacing: 0; } }

components.name: Checkpoint readout
components.description: A dark backing protects cyan distance and wrapped support text from skyline detail.
components.css: .ds-checkpoint-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; container-type: inline-size; } .ds-checkpoint { padding: 10px; background: #1a1b26f5; color: var(--text, #c0caf5); font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; text-align: right; text-shadow: 0 2px 4px var(--bg, #16161e); } .ds-checkpoint-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 10px; letter-spacing: 1px; } .ds-checkpoint strong { display: block; color: var(--cyan, #7dcfff); font-family: 'Arcade', monospace; font-size: clamp(12px, 1.8cqw, 22px); font-weight: 400; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-checkpoint small { font: 12px 'Courier New', monospace; } .ds-checkpoint-detail { display: block; margin-top: 10px; color: var(--muted, #9aa5ce); letter-spacing: .4px; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-checkpoint { padding: 6px; } .ds-checkpoint-label { margin-bottom: 8px; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-checkpoint strong { font-size: 14px; } .ds-checkpoint-detail { margin-top: 7px; max-width: 90px; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: 0; } }

components.name: Keyboard legend
components.description: Outlined keycaps identify physical keys. The deeper bottom border distinguishes them from action buttons.
components.css: .ds-key-legend { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; color: var(--muted, #9aa5ce); font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .3px; } .ds-key-legend kbd { box-sizing: border-box; min-width: 25px; height: 28px; padding: 5px; border: 1px solid #414868; border-bottom-width: 3px; border-radius: 3px; color: var(--text, #c0caf5); font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 12px; text-align: center; } .ds-key-legend .ds-wide-key { padding-inline: 10px; line-height: 15px; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-key-legend { gap: 8px; } .ds-key-legend kbd { min-width: 23px; } }

narrative.overview:
An after-hours arcade cabinet frames a Tokyo expressway in hard-edged pixel art. Tokyo Night indigo, neon signs, and a yellow Lamborghini Countach establish the identity.

A compact instrument interface keeps the road and car prominent. The skyline, road, vehicles, driver portraits, and boost cameos use original procedural artwork.
keyCharacteristics: A yellow Countach anchors the behind-the-car view.
Tokyo Night colors connect the interface and scene.
Pixel titles pair with compact monospace labels.
Rectangular controls frame a responsive canvas.
Driver selection uses native radios and pixel portrait canvases.
Occasional boost cameos feature the selected driver.
The original Omarchy text-block logo marks the start screen and roadside signs.

rules.name: The Shared Palette Rule
rules.body: Use the same Tokyo Night accents in the interface and the procedural scene.

rules.name: The Instrument Type Rule
rules.body: Use Arcade for titles, primary actions, and main instrument values. Use Courier New for supporting labels and instructions.

dos: Do preserve the yellow Countach and behind-the-car pixel view.
Do share the Tokyo Night palette between interface controls and procedural artwork.
Do keep the full road width and visible touch controls through responsive and fullscreen states.
Do preserve focus outlines, text-backed status, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do preserve the supplied Omarchy text-block logo on the start screen and roadside signs.
donts: Don't smooth the pixel artwork or replace its hard-edged geometry with photographic imagery.
Don't replace rectangular arcade controls with pill-shaped controls.
Don't let skyline detail obscure checkpoint information.
Don't repeat the cameo continuously during one held boost.
